scope: CVG-004 failed report-delivery retry finalization lease-expiry fencing

criteria.description: Fresh repository-local reconciliation identified that in-memory retry claims reject expiry while PostgreSQL saveClaimedDelivery checks account, delivery id and token but not active claim_until.
criteria.limitations: Selection is direct source/test evidence; it is not implementation, independent approval or production certification.

criteria.description: The existing report delivery lease schema already persists claim_token, claim_until and claim_worker_id, so the correction can remain a repository-local conditional UPDATE without a migration.
criteria.limitations: The SQL behavior remains unverified until the intentional RED/GREEN PostgreSQL test runs.

criteria.description: The bounded fix is an active-expiry predicate on retry finalization, preserving the existing boolean contract, active-claim success, takeover rejection and service/provider APIs.
criteria.limitations: Provider side effects, retry policy, renewal, target and global readiness remain explicit non-claims.

criteria.description: The test boundary covers the stale pre-takeover expiry case plus active success and existing post-takeover stale-token behavior before bounded closure.
criteria.limitations: RED/GREEN implementation, regression, coverage, review and final control-plane reconciliation remain open.

gaps: Intentional RED/GREEN, focused PostgreSQL proof, regression, quality, independent review and final gate evidence remain open.
Provider side effects/idempotency, retry policy, renewal, target/production/deployment/release and global ERP remain out of scope.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation and direct read-only residual reconciliation
authority.scope: Repository-local PostgreSQL retry-delivery lease-expiry predicate and bounded active/stale finalization proof
authority.decision: Authorize only the active claim_until predicate on saveClaimedDelivery and its focused tests. Preserve existing claim/retry/provider contracts and exclude provider behavior, renewal, target, production, deployment, release and global ERP promotion.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing retry policy, redrive/reconciliation states, claim renewal/clock semantics, provider invocation, migration shape or target/production/deployment/release scope.

next_action: Write and run the intentional RED test for expiry-before-takeover, then add the active-expiry predicate and run focused PostgreSQL regressions. Keep all global/non-local boundaries blocked.
revalidation_triggers: Changing failed-delivery claim selection, retry policy, redrive or reconciliation state
Changing lease renewal, claim clock semantics or migration shape
Changing provider invocation, idempotency or external delivery semantics
Adding target, production, deployment, backup/restore, release or global parity behavior
